name: Database
description: SurrealDB access mediated by the kernel. Plugins never open a DB connection or send queries of their own; the kernel scopes every call to the active org and the plugin's allowed models.

capabilities.name: Query
capabilities.description: Structured reads: get / find by model name. The kernel builds parameterized queries, and only for models the plugin was granted.

capabilities.name: Mutate
capabilities.description: Structured writes: create, update and delete by model name. This is the capability the kernel checks for db::create, db::update and db::delete.

capabilities.name: Bulk Mutation
capabilities.description: Capability for running multiple create, update or delete at once.

capabilities.name: Transaction
capabilities.description: Run a batch of structured db::* ops inscodee a single transaction.
